description:
Port upstream resource-loader.ts getAgentsFiles() to Elixir.

Upstream behavior (agent-session.ts:913, resource-loader.ts):
- Walk from cwd upward to filesystem root looking for CLAUDE.md, then AGENTS.md
- First match per directory wins (CLAUDE.md preferred over AGENTS.md)
- Also load global ~/.pi/CLAUDE.md (or ~/.pi/AGENTS.md) if it exists
- Return list of {path, content} maps injected as context_files into system prompt
- Config dir name is ".pi"

Implementation:
- New module: OctoPi.Coder.ResourceLoader.ContextFiles
- walk_for_context_file/1 — walk dirs from cwd upward, return first CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md found per level
- load_global/0 — load ~/.pi/CLAUDE.md or ~/.pi/AGENTS.md
- load_all/1 — combine project chain + global, dedup by path
- Returns [{path: string, content: string}] matching SystemPrompt.render context_files format

Tests must cover:
- cwd with CLAUDE.md present
- ancestor directory has CLAUDE.md (no local)
- AGENTS.md fallback when CLAUDE.md absent
- Global file loaded alongside local chain
- No files present → empty list
- Dedup (same file path not returned twice)

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts getAgentsFiles()
title: Context file discovery: CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md upward walk
